Initiative
Each turn, both Pokémon gain Initiative based on their speed stats. When a player matches 4 or more tiles in a row, they get a free turn.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey, hey! ^^$@blue|Welcome!@$^^

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Thanks for tryin' this little game. Not to go tooting horns, but this to^^ok $@red|A LOT!@$$@wait-10|@$ of ^^effort.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: That's a nice %c-pname% you got there! Let's see how they are in a friendly match!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Aww, you got me! That was a tough fight! Hey, tell me when you want to have another go at it, alright?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey, no worries! You can’t win them all.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I heard some Pokémon are better against others, anyway. I can’t wait for next time!

effects.speaker: Jimmy
effects.text: Hey, you! Check out my cool dog!

effects.speaker: Audrey
effects.text: Hey, thanks for not telling my brother that his Pokémon isn't a dog. I know that took restraint.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Oh, hey again! Have you caught any new Pokémon?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: You've caught %c% Pokémon!

effects.speaker: Kevin
effects.text: Hey, have you seen my big sister? She said she was coming with Gully... oh well! Let's have a battle while we wait!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Y'know how Wingull are always stealing your snacks on the beach?

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: I've got a little secret for you!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: It was the same Wingull every time.

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Gully here has been single-handedly making people buy a new order of fries for years.

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: He's a $@start-italics|@$smart$@end-italics|@$ little kleptomaniac, isn't he?

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: But now you that know my secret... I can’t let you go telling people about it!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Arghhh! Fine, you beat me! But please, don't tell anyone about Gully's crimes!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: He's a sweet little horrible thing! Just... keep this between us, okay?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Hello...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Will you...
Will you...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Could you please...
Could you please...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Um... I'm really sorry to bother you, but...
Um... I'm really sorry to bother you, but...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^My name is Lillie.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I... I need help getting to the trainers' school. It's just a little further... but there are so many mean-looking Pokémon up ahead!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I don't want to be late... ^^Oh, I can give you one of the professor's spare $@red|Pokédex@$es^^ for your trouble!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Phew...$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Thank you so much for helping me out there.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I'll get out of your hair. The professor probably needs me, anyway. Thank you again!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh! ^^Before I go! This school is having a special lesson today.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Ms. Emily wants their students to get some practice battling Pokémon with other trainers! You should help her out!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: Did I hear that right?! Are you guys part of today's lesson?!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: I^^ can’t wait! I've even been^^ working on a cool thing tor me and my Pokémon to say!^^

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$*ahem*$@end-italics|@$$@wait-10|@$
*ahem*

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: They say the early bird gets the worm...... but I hope it also wins this battle!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: Aww, dang. But be honest, was my line at least a $@start-italics|@$little$@end-italics|@$ cool?

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: Yay, my turn my turn! Uh... me and my Pokémon are gonna $@start-italics|@$rock$@end-italics|@$ your world!

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$A^^wwwwww...$@end-italics|@$ Mister Wobbles wobbled too hard...

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: Alright, lemme show you two how it's $@start-italics|@$really$@end-italics|@$ done!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: This Pokémon I caught yesterday is practically invincible!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: How did you defeat my unbeatable strategy?! I guess I should teach Podzilla more moves...

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Hmph. What was your plan there, Joey? Just let your Metapod get squashed?

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Let me take a swing at them. Sit back and watch a future Pokémon champion at work!

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$What?!$@end-bold|@$ How the heck did— How did I lose?! That— that can’t be right!

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Grrr... Maybe I need to train more. I'm gonna be the champion one day!

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Oh, there you are, Joseph. And Hiromi, Joey, Mia... wait, is everyone already finished? What happened?

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Oh! You're not the trainer I was expecting... but, judging by all these fainted Pokémon, I think I can guess what happened.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Well, no harm done. The lesson was about battling, and thanks to you, they got $@start-italics|@$plenty$@end-italics|@$ of experience.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Since everyone's already battled... I guess there's no harm in one last match, right? Think of it as... $@start-italics|@$extra credit$@end-italics|@$.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Whew$@end-italics|@$... You really know how to keep a class on their toes.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Well, that's everyone in the school. You've got some skills.

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: I'm gonna make up more cool battle lines!

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: Me and Mister Wobbles are gonna be just as good as you when we grow up!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: I just looked up what Metapod evolves into, I think I'm gonna have to rename him soon...

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Yes, even though you weren't the special guest I was expecting, you certainly helped quite a bit. I hope he's alright...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Hey, uh... sorry to interrupt, but the professor and I are finished.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Apparently he's got something planned for later today... but anyway, he asked about you. Sorry, you just came up in conversation...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Anyway, he wants me to take you to Hau'oli City. I think he thinks you're doing the island challenge thing? I don't know...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I can take you there, if you'd like.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: Some time later...

effects.speaker: The Masked Royal
effects.text: Alright! Who's ready to throw down?!

effects.speaker: The Masked Royal
effects.text: Where'd everybody go?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Why hello! You don't look like you're from here, if you don't mind my saying so. How are you enjoying Hau'oli city?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Am I correct in assuming you're visiting to partake in the island challenge?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: You $@start-italics|@$suppose$@end-italics|@$ so? That's not often the response I'm accustomed to hear—

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Yo, yo, yo! Look who we found out and about! Tryna act tough? Well, knock it out!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Y'all talk big with your island trial, but here's Team Skull to cramp your style!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: It's island $@start-italics|@$challenge$@end-italics|@$, actually. Anyway, %c%, if we may continue—

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Hey! Hold up! We're challengin' ya here!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Yeah, c'mon! You're supposed to be all intimidated with the boot-quakin' and stuff!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Oh, $@start-italics|@$fine$@end-italics|@$... if you must. %c%, may I have you deal with these two for me?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: In the meantime, I will be doing anything else.^^ Be back soon!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Man... this always happens, B. Why's this $@start-italics|@$always$@end-italics|@$ gotta happen?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: I know, I know... but like, maybe we shouldn't be jumpin' people who are right next to the best trainer in the city?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$Fiiiine$@end-bold|@$... you told me so, is that what you wanna hear?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Let's just leave before that pompous prince gets back and starts like, givin' us battle tips or somethin'.

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Yeah, you guys got lucky this time! Next time we'll bring THREE guys, then whatcha gonna do?!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Three guys! The magic number! You guys don't stand a chance!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Is Ilima coming back?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I think he's over there shopping.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I'll go get him...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: (Yes, I'm coming, I'm coming... how are you so strong?)

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Hello again. In recognition of your efforts, I am obliged to battle with you so as to test your worth in the island challenge, and what have you.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only captain Ilima!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well done! That was certainly a battle.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I mean no offense, but I $@start-italics|@$was$@end-italics|@$ going easy on you, since you helped with those thugs.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Maybe one day, we'll be able to have another battle.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Would you mind helping me with something, dear?

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: I'm working to create a very special perfume. A $@start-italics|@$signature scent$@end-italics|@$ of mine.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: I find that, if my $@red|perfume@$ battles, her scent becomes... more appealing. It helps to release those $@start-italics|@$richer$@end-italics|@$ notes.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: The last time she battled, her scent gained these ^^wonderful^^ whiffs of lavender.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Let's see what new scents she can unlock from battling $@start-italics|@$you!$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Oof... that scent is downright overbearing.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Wait, do I detect a hint of^^...^^ just $@start-italics|@$what$@end-italics|@$ is this new texture in her aroma?

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: That's... heavenly! Thank you, dear. Once I get my baby back into shape, she'll produce the most sought-after, limited-edition scent in Alola!

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: Howdy! I just saw you while I was setting up my camp for the night.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: I'm all set for the night, now! So, wanna battle while the sun's still up?

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: I don't have a lot of Pokémon, I packed light. All I've got is Soozle, here.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: We've been camping together for years! She makes a $@start-italics|@$great$@end-italics|@$ pillow.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: Aw, dang. Well, I guess she'll be pretty tired tonight. Let's get you rested up, okay?

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: You decide not to have a trainer battle in the cemetery because something tells you that these trainers might not be interested right now.

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Hey! You, uh— trainer person! You look like you've got some strong Pokémon! I need your help, come on!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: A bunch of those weird Skull guys are making a ruckus on the berry farm! Pa's trying to drive them out, but they just won't take a hint!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Yo, I'm not gonna say it again, old man— hand over the berries!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt D
effects.text: Yeah, hand 'em over! Us Team Skull guys got a sweet tooth!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: These berries ain't for people. I'd be happy to give them to any Pokémon for free, but never to thieves like you!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: So you're saying I'm lower than a Pokémon? I already got self-esteem issues, man!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: This here's a berry farm, not a free sample station. Now get, before I let out the Tauros!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Pa, I brought backup! Stranger, think you could help drive these pests out for us?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Man... we lost again?! All we wanted was a couple berries, and maybe, like... mild bragging rights!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt D
effects.text: Bro, we're outta Pokémon, we're outta berries... and now we're even outta our league! This stinks!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Let's get outta here before the old man^^ makes us mulch!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Whew, that was incredible! Thanks stranger, you were a real help!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: Yep, if you ever want something, come on down to the farm and we'll give you as many berries as you'd like.

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Maybe one day that line'll be important if I ever decide to program held items into this thing! Don't hold your breath!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Ah, welcome, challenger! You're just in time for the commencement of the Trial of Melemele Island's Verdant Cavern!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Which, yes, may $@start-italics|@$technically$@end-italics|@$ consist of nothing more than a small rodent infestation, but don't let that diminish the gravity of the task!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Ooooh,$@end-italics|@$ are we fighting a boss already?! I can’t wait!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: No... it's really just a few Yungoos and Rattata...$@wait-20|@$ ^^oh, he's already gone. Look, can I be honest with the two of you?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Look, there's nothing exciting in that cave. I'm paid to oversee something that feels special, and this cave thing definitely works for $@start-italics|@$some$@end-italics|@$ people, but...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I mean, it's literally just 3 Rattata. One of them's a little bigger than the others.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: This whole thing is just a formality, I just need to check that you're $@start-italics|@$capable$@end-italics|@$ trainers, not stupid ones.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Let's just have a battle, instead. I've got some more capable Pokémon on me.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Oh. Well, alright. Have fun, I guess. I'll be waiting out here.
effects.label: skipTo

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Ah, you've returned victorious! I could practically $@start-italics|@$feel$@end-italics|@$ the energy of your climactic battle coming from the cave.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Now, with your triumph over this trial, I am $@font-size:0.6|@$mildly enthused$@font-size:1|@$ to present the three of you with these emblems as proof of your mastery.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I didn't do anything...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Nonsense! Young lady, you endured the $@start-italics|@$bone-chilling$@end-italics|@$ atmosphere of the Verdant Cavern! And, quite honestly, I ordered these in bulk.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I have two more boons to give you, as well: A $@red|Normalium Z-Crystal@$ and a $@red|Z-Power Ring@$.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: With these, you will be able to use $@red|Normal-type Z-moves@$.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: In battle, whenever it's charged and you have a Normal-type Pokémon active, the crystal will glow, and your Normal-type moves will be powered up!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well done! That was quite invigorating. I daresay that you've earned your passage— not through pest control, but through panache!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I should really offer this little opportunity to more trial-goers. As it stands, I have to wait here until... whoever that other child was finishes.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I really must start imposing time limits on trial attempts. Maybe install signage?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well, it's no matter now. Here, both of you, take these emblems as proof of your passage.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I didn't do anything...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Young lady, I am close to certain that you could defeat 3 rats. Please just take the emblem.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I have two more boons to give you, as well: A $@red|Normalium Z-Crystal@$ and a $@red|Z-Power Ring@$.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: With these, you will be able to use $@red|Normal-type Z-moves@$.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: In battle, whenever it's charged and you have a Normal-type Pokémon active, the crystal will glow, and your Normal-type moves will be powered up!

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: The traveler paused at a crossroads, unaware of the trial fate had laid before them...

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: That trial... was me. ^^Tatiana.$@wait-10|@$ Rising star.$@wait-10|@$ Future champion.$@wait-10|@$ Heroine of a saga still unfolding!

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: You've wandered into the as-of-yet-unwritten chapter seven, page one: $@start-italics|@$The Duel of Destiny$@end-italics|@$.

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: Let's make it a good one! Feel free to throw in some plot twists— let the battle begin!

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: You round a corner along the path, and see a trainer walking two Pokémon on leashes.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: One leash is taut, dragging behind him, and the other is flapping constantly, as the Pokémon races around the trainer.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: Rockruff, $@start-italics|@$heel!$@end-italics|@$ Slowpoke, $@start-italics|@$hurry!$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: I'm just trying to walk my Pokémon, but they're making it $@start-italics|@$so$@end-italics|@$ hard.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: It's $@start-italics|@$supposed$@end-italics|@$ to be good for bonding, but it's more like being dragged around by one and $@start-italics|@$trying$@end-italics|@$ to drag the other.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: Care for a battle? Rockruff really needs to vent some energy, and my arms are starting to hurt.

effects.speaker: Thistle
effects.text: Ah, I heard the commotion. Looks like you've been busy.

effects.speaker: Thistle
effects.text: It's nice to see someone else taking in the natural beauty of the meadow, here.

effects.speaker: Thistle
effects.text: Melemele Meadow doesn't get a lot of visitors. These Pokémon seem to have gotten plenty of... enrichment, though.

effects.speaker: Thistle
effects.text: Before you go, would you like to have a friendly battle? I always love seeing the pollen get kicked up when Pokémon battle!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey there, %c%! Almost ready for the next trial?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I actually just finished mine— the Kahuna has some strong Pokémon!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Oh, by the way, I should mention: He'll use a different team depending on how many Pokémon you bring! So it's a fair challenge, y'know?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Anyway, I'm still raring to go for another battle! And hey, if you can beat me, you can definitely take on the kahuna!

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$$@font-size:1.2|@$Ho!$@font-size:1|@$$@end-bold|@$ I have been waiting for you, %c%!

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: Allow me to properly greet the young adventurer embarking on the island challenge.

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: I am Hala, kahuna of Melemele Island. To pass this grand trial, you must withstand the blows of my Pokémon!

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: If you defeat me, I will teach you and your Pokémon how to use $@red|Fighting-type@$ Z-moves!

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: Ha! Well done! My old bones know how to take a good loss.

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: The island has seen your resolve, and so have I. As kahuna, I hereby officially declare you a worthy trainer.

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: You've exceeded my expectations! From now on, your Pokémon will be able to use $@red|Fighting-type@$ Z-moves!

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: If you want to continue your journey through the island challenge, your next destination would be Akala island.

effects.speaker: Hala
effects.text: I wish you luck with the rest of your journey, %c%.

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: So, $@start-italics|@$you're$@end-italics|@$ the one who got past Hala, huh? I assume he gave you the same advice as me when I was your age.

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: I'm glad the tradition's still going.

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: When I was your age, I got really mad at all the adults acting like roadblocks until they said I was “^^strong enough.”

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: But I promise, they have good reason. It definitely helped me a lot, growing up.

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: And to be honest... I've kinda always been waiting for a moment like this, when I can be someone else's roadblock!

effects.speaker: Sheri
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$$@font-size:1.2|@$En garde!$@font-size:1|@$$@end-bold|@$$@wait-20|@$

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Oh! Hello there. I hope I didn't accidentally bonk you with any of my practice shots.

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Usually it's just me and the Pokémon out here, and they don't seem to mind me practicing. $@font-size:0.6|@$Although I may have given that Spinda a concussion... $@font-size:0.5|@$(not that anyone could tell.)$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Anyway, it's nice to meet you. Are you taking part in the island challenge?

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Judging by that Z-Power Ring, you don't know how to use $@red|Flying-type@$ Z-moves yet, do you?

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: I could teach you. But, well, I want to see what you're made of first!

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Well! I can tell you show some promise.

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: We'll definitely meet again, and next time we do, it'll be off the green!

effects.speaker: Kahili
effects.text: Here, take this Z-crystal and get on your way. I need to get back to practicing my forward swing.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: Your Flying-type Pokémon can now use Z-moves!

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: Ahhh... this hotel is something else, Dex. Can we hang out here a little longer?

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$sigh$@end-italics|@$$@wait-10|@$
sigh

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: You already know we can’t, Sina. We need to head out to get some data. There'll be $@start-italics|@$plenty$@end-italics|@$ of time to relax once we're done.

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: Can we at $@start-italics|@$least$@end-italics|@$ get that data on the beach? Think about it, if new trainers show up, that's where they gotta come from, right?

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: ...Not a bad point, actually. Sure, let's go.

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: Hey! I think that's one of those “island challenge” trainers!

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: I think you're right... hey, want to help with a research study?

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: We're researchers from Kalos here on official research purposes to take observations, mainly focused on this “Z-Power” phenomenon.

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: That's the intent, anyway. So far, we've mainly been focused on if these malasada things live up to the hype.

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: That's beside the point.

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: (They do.)

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: Thank you Sina.$@wait-10|@$ So, we've been looking for trainers like you, wearing bracelets like yours.

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: Seeing the kinds of Pokémon trainers use here and the kinds of moves they know—$@wait-10|@$

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: I think they understand, Dex. Anyway, wanna battle? For the sake of science, of course.

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: Nice! These are some very useful readings. The energy coming from that bracelet is even more interesting than I expected...

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: That's his way of saying thank you. Thanks for helping with our little study, buddy!

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: We'll be off looking for more trainers, getting more data points, that kind of thing...

effects.speaker: Dexio
effects.text: ...Checking out that golf course we saw when we flew in maybe...

effects.speaker: Sina
effects.text: Ooh! May$@start-italics|@$be$@end-italics|@$, Dex! See ya around!

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: As you continue, you see a man talking animatedly to a Drifloon.

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: Hmm... perhaps I could have you carry the guests' bags to their rooms?

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: The laundry chutes don't get too much use, so maybe you could travel that way?

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: Oh, hello. Sorry, I didn't see you approach!

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: I've been told to do more to “innovate” Tide Song Hotel. So I thought... tourists come to Alola to see the region's Pokémon, right?

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: So I'm trying to come up with some ideas for how some local Pokémon can help add some pizzazz!

effects.speaker: Jody
effects.text: It's not going... too well, so far, if I'm honest. They seem like they could use a break. Wanna have a battle so they can let off some steam?

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: Whew! Well, they definitely show promise... I'll keep working on making Tide Song Hotel the greatest in Alola!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: Hey! Are you a tourist too? There's so many cool Pokémon here!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: Earlier I saw a Rattata with a $@start-italics|@$mustache$@end-italics|@$!!! He looks like he runs a little restaurant or something!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: Everything is cooler here! The trees are wavier, the food is tastier, the Meowth are meaner...

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: I could do without that last part! One of them stole my phone! I $@start-italics|@$still$@end-italics|@$ don't have my phone! This thing in my hand is just a vaguely phone-shaped rock!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: C’mon, battle me! I wanna show you all my new Pokémon!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: Neat! I'm gonna try and find the way out of here now!

effects.speaker: Scotty
effects.text: I have NO idea which way is out.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: (There is a very clear path that you follow out of the forest.)

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey %c%! You made it past the first trial!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Check out these old west vibes! I’ve never felt anything like this back home!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: It’s so cool seeing all these Pokémon they don’t have on Melemele island!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I even caught a few new favorites...

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: And I just can’t wait to show ’em off!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Let’s battle!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Man!$@end-italics|@$ How’d you come up with a battle plan like that?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I guess I’ve gotta keep training! I’ll go start making my way to the next trial!

effects.speaker: Gerald
effects.text: Howdy, trainer! I haven’t seen you around the ranch before. Welcome to Paniola Ranch, finest ranch in Alola.

effects.speaker: Gerald
effects.text: It’s not $@start-italics|@$my$@end-italics|@$ ranch or anything. I’m just friends with the owner.

effects.speaker: Gerald
effects.text: Hey, fun fact, did you know “Paniola” is Hawaiian for “cowboy?” I’m... not at all sure what a “Hawaii” is, but... something just tells me that’s true.

effects.speaker: Gerald
effects.text: I give that little info nugget to all the newcomers I see! Which ain’t many! So while you’re here, wanna battle?$@wait-10|@$

effects.speaker: Wesley
effects.text: Gerald! They’re loose again! Tauros got riled up— somethin’ spooked the whole herd!

effects.speaker: Wesley
effects.text: You, trainer— can you help a bit? Gerald and I’ll do what we can, we just need all the help we can get!

effects.speaker: Wesley
effects.text: Whew... thanks for your help, trainer. We really gotta keep this li’l thing in its own pen.

effects.speaker: Gerald
effects.text: I know you’re new here, trainer, but this is NOT the first time she’s caused a ruckus.

effects.speaker: Wesley
effects.text: You were a big help. I’m gonna go get her fed and calmed down.

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: Ah! Be careful where you step— the mushrooms are watching.

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: Hi there. I’m Yuka. I’m just tending my little fairy ring, here... Isn’t it so pretty how they glow?

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: Did you know Morelull spores are so light, they can drift for miles on the wind?

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: My little ones tell me lots about the other parts of Alola...

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: You’re $@start-italics|@$%c%$@end-italics|@$, aren’t you? Hehehe, I knew it...

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: They say that if you fall asleep near a Morelull, you’ll dream the same dream. That’s what $@start-italics|@$they$@end-italics|@$ tell me, at least.

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: Wanna have a battle? My little ones $@start-italics|@$love$@end-italics|@$ to watch!

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: Oh, the little ones $@start-italics|@$loved$@end-italics|@$ that!

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: They’re very grateful for the entertainment...

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: You should come back sometime! They seem to like you a lot!

effects.speaker: Yuka
effects.text: I’ll let you get on your way, now. Have fun meeting that blond kid!

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: (As you walk back where you came from, you realize you can’t actually remember when you started walking off of the path...)

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: (In any case, you reach the edge of the forest without incident, though you can definitely feel something watching you as you leave.)

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: Tch. You’re wasting my time. If you’re ^^$@start-italics|@$this$@end-italics|@$ weak, ^^you may as well just quit pretending you’re a ^^trainer^^.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey! I’m $@font-size:1.2|@$NOT$@font-size:1|@$ pretending! I just... ^^forgot to heal my Pokémon before this!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I was kinda ^^$@start-italics|@$expecting$@end-italics|@$ to heal them at the Pokémon Center just up ahead!

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: ^^$@start-italics|@$Excuses!$@end-italics|@$$@wait-4|@$ Get out of here, kid.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Oh, hey, ^^%c%! You’re just in time. This ^^$@start-italics|@$jerk$@end-italics|@$ won’t let^^ me past to Brooklet Hill!

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: Team Skull wants no witnesses.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Exactly, yeah, so you keep saying. What do those losers even matter to you, man?

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: I don’t have any loyalty to those thugs! Their boss just pays well... to keep weaklings like $@start-italics|@$you$@end-italics|@$ out!

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: $@font-size:0.8|@$Hmph... it’s not like me to slip up like that.$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: $@font-size:0.8|@$I’ve got to keep fighting stronger opponents... Looks like I'm still not ready...$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: See that, kid? $@start-italics|@$Those$@end-italics|@$ are strong Pokémon! $@start-italics|@$That$@end-italics|@$ is how a trainer should act!

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: You, you’re... not even taking this seriously. It’s fine to enjoy battling, but you...

effects.speaker: Gladion
effects.text: You’re just using it as an excuse, so you don’t have to try hard! Just because you’re worried you’ll never beat your old man when he’s serious!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: You know my gramps? Wait, so you think I could beat him? You think I’m strong?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt E
effects.text: Awww, look at li’l Gladion! Playing with your $@start-italics|@$friends? $@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt F
effects.text: And oh, would you look at what they’re doing? They’re $@start-italics|@$witnessing$@end-italics|@$, Gladion. I guess you didn’t do your job very well, huh?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt E
effects.text: Lucky for you, it doesn’t matter either way. This place was a $@start-italics|@$bust.$@end-italics|@$ Let’s just get outta here and tell the boss it was a waste of time.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Thanks for the help, %c%! You really saved my bacon, there.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I guess I’ve really gotta work on making my Pokémon stronger. I’ll be training all day for the next trial at Brooklet Hill!

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: ^^Hi! Welcome to Brooklet Hill, home of the finest fishing spots in Alola!

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I’m Lana, a trial captain! That $@blue|little bracelet@$ tells me you might be interested in that, right?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Oh, ^^yay! You actually came at a great time, we’re having a bit of an issue with—

effects.speaker: Mikiko
effects.text: Hey guys, I just came from up ^^that way, there’s some weirdos acting pretty... I dunno, defensive?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$Oh, uh... how so?$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Mikiko
effects.text: Like, they’re $@start-italics|@$intense$@end-italics|@$. Just wanted to warn you if you’re headed up there.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$Oh,^^ those guys are back again...$@font-size:1|@$^^

effects.speaker: Mikiko
effects.text: So yeah, I’m totally headed to the Pokémon Center to fix up my Pokémon.

effects.speaker: Mikiko
effects.text: Before I go though, wanna have a... $@start-italics|@$friendlier$@end-italics|@$ battle? My Pokémon could use a confidence boost.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$I’ll go^^$@wait-5|@$ try and deal with those guys. Uh, consider this part of your trial, I guess!$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$Guys, can you please... I uh, need this lake for a bit, we’re doing, uh... well, we’re trying to do the trial and—$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Hal
effects.text: Oh, what’s this? You’re bringing more land walkers to $@start-italics|@$our$@end-italics|@$ waters, $@start-italics|@$captain?$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$Well, yes, and I know you guys like this spot, but... well, we just need you to make some room for—$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Ernest
effects.text: Make some room? This is our $@start-bold|@$prime fishing spot!$@end-bold|@$

effects.speaker: Herbert
effects.text: It’s been in the family for three generations!

effects.speaker: Ernest
effects.text: You think we’re just gonna $@start-italics|@$reel in our lines$@end-italics|@$ ‘cause some trial-goer just $@start-italics|@$decides$@end-italics|@$ to come by?

effects.speaker: Carl
effects.text: And who even is this? Yet another wide-eyed $@start-italics|@$tourist?$@end-italics|@$ That thinks they can just walk in and scare off all the fish?

effects.speaker: Hal
effects.text: There’s only $@start-bold|@$one$@end-bold|@$ way to settle this!

effects.speaker: Ernest
effects.text: Yeah! Let’s make ‘em prove they belong!

effects.speaker: Herbert
effects.text: Battle us, you piece of chum!

effects.speaker: Ernest
effects.text: Hey, man, that’s too far. C’mon, Herbert.

effects.speaker: Herbert
effects.text: You’re right, sorry.

effects.speaker: Ernest
effects.text: We’re still battling, though!

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$...I think you’re just gonna have to indulge these guys.$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: $@font-size:0.9|@$I’m sorry. I promise the real trial will be more structured than this.$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Finally! I’m so sorry for all that... Hopefully we can start the trial now?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Those fishermen did have a good reason to want to fish here. This spot is different from everywhere else here.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: No one’s sure of why exactly this is true, but some Water Pokémon get a power boost here!

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: So that’s your trial. If you win, I’ll teach you and your Pokémon how to use $@blue|Water-type Z-moves@$.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Good luck! Head into the center of the lake when you’re ready.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Very well done! Clear skies once again.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I apologize, ^^again,$@wait-20|@$^^ for how bumpy this whole thing started.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: And I have to say, I’m a bit conflicted about how ^^$@start-italics|@$easy$@end-italics|@$$@wait-10|@$^^ you made that look...

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I spent a long time training those Pokémon, and not once but ^^$@start-italics|@$twice$@end-italics|@$ today, they’re defeated.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Oh well. Would you say I made it challenging enough?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Why thank you. I do try to make it at least a bit challenging, so that’s really nice to hear.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Though... maybe next time I’ll throw my Gyarados into the mix, too. Just to keep people honest. Hehe.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I suppose it’s time for your reward. Here, take this Z-crystal.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.label: skipTo
effects.text: Oh. Well, I’m sorry to hear that.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I did train those Pokémon myself. Maybe I pushed them a bit too far...

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Well, the important thing is that you passed. Here, take this Z-crystal.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.label: merge
effects.text: From now on, your $@blue|Water-type@$ Pokémon can power up their Water-type moves.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Y’know, it’s interesting that trainers $@start-italics|@$always$@end-italics|@$ come here for Water Z-moves before Fire or Grass ones, right?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Like, they know that there doesn’t really have to be a specific order to this whole island challenge thing, right?

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: I guess everyone thinks that, given a choice, they should pick the cute little Water guy and nobody else.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: And they’re right, but I just think that’s interesting.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Anyway, if you wanna follow The Order™, my buddy Kiawe is probably somewhere ^^up there right now.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: (She points at the peak of the island’s tallest mountain, looking at you for a reaction.)

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: Between you and me, I think his Pokémon are kinda pushovers, but don’t tell him that.

effects.speaker: Lana
effects.text: See you later!

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: As you walk along the dirt path, you approach a woman dancing alongside several Oricorio.

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: Hiii! My little dancers and I were just about to finish practice for the day.

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: As you... can probably tell, we’ve given up on trying to match each other’s styles.

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: Nanea here is the only one who I can even keep up with...

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: They all have these whole vibes that are just, $@start-italics|@$different,$@end-italics|@$ right? I’m not even completely sure what a “sensu” dance is.

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: This little ball of energy is $@start-italics|@$incapable$@end-italics|@$ of being still for even a moment. I’ve tried to calm her down. I $@start-italics|@$think$@end-italics|@$ she’s tried, too. (Like 60% sure.)

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: When I caught this one, and tried to get her to dance with me, she just bit me. I still have the mark on my finger!

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: I don’t really understand why they’re so... so set in their favorite style, but, well, I guess I’m stuck in mine too...

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: But that’s the beauty of them, don’t you think? Oricorio is one of the only Pokémon I know of that act so differently...

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: All moving to the beat of their own drum, living entirely at their own tempo and so unafraid to show it...

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: Now that I’ve told you all about us, I’d love to see your style too!

effects.speaker: Maika
effects.text: Ready for a battle?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh, %c%! There you are! Were you and Hau able to finish your trials?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh, me? Sorry, at some point in the forest, we got separated... so I just headed back here to the city.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I’m really glad you’re back, though... sorry, but being alone so far from home really shook me up.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: There were a lot of signs talking about this big building here. They call it the “Battle Royal Dome.”

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh, wait, sorry, it’s “Royale,” not “Royal.” It says on this map that they “just liked it better that way.” They just haven’t changed all the signs yet.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Anyway, from what I saw, apparently this is some kind of tournament.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: They’ll randomly place contestants against other trainers until only one is left undefeated.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: That does sound interesting, I guess. %c%, would you like to watch one before continuing on?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.label: participate
effects.text: Oh! A-alright, I guess! It looks like registration is right over there, I’ll... cheer you on from the audience, I suppose.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.label: watch
effects.text: Great! I’ll go get us tickets.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: (You have a nice time watching the competition alongside Lillie.)

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh... well, that’s fine. I think I’ll just... watch it myself, then. Have fun with whatever trial is next, %c%.

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Welcome, welcome, trainers of all ages! To Akala’s Battle Royale!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Sixteen trainers from all four islands and beyond have gathered to give our audience the best show on Alola!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Getting defeated even once will knock any trainer out for the rest of the tournament— so keep those Pokémon sharp!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: I won’t keep you waiting any longer! Our first battle begins now!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: In this corner... %c%! And in this corner...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Our next contestant is...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: The tournament is heating up, folks! We’re down to the semifinals!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Only two rounds remain until we see who comes out on top!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: For our next battle, %c% will be facing...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: There’s just one match left, folks! Sixteen trainers entered the tournament... but only two are left standing!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: This is it! The final round to determine who shall be crowned as today’s Battle Royale Champion!!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: I must say, you’ve made quite a first impression, %c%!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Not everyone has what it takes to get this far!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: The final showdown, the main event! The dark horse, %c%, will be facing...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: What a battle, folks! With that, the tournament comes to an end!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: $@font-size:0.96|@$I sincerely hope that everyone in the audience, and especially each of our wonderful contestants, enjoyed their time at the Battle Royale Dome!$@font-size:1|@$

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Today’s Battle Royale Champion is... %c%!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Wow! I can’t believe you actually won!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I’ll be honest, I was doubting you!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: In any case, that was certainly enjoyable to watch. Should we go on to the next trial? I believe it’s up the volcano, right?

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Ooh, tough luck, folks! That’s curtains for %c%!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Feel free to sign up again any time! We're always looking for new trainers!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: ...Hana, the Glittering Queen!

effects.speaker: Hana
effects.text: Every battle is a runway. I only use Pokémon that $@start-italics|@$sparkle!$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Hana
effects.text: Ugh... you ruined my baby’s beautiful fur...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Oof! The runway lights go dim for Hana!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: ...Mr. Fix, Akala’s resident gear-grinding genius!

effects.speaker: Mr. Fix
effects.text: My team runs smoother than a freshly-oiled engine!

effects.speaker: Mr. Fix
effects.text: Aw, nuts... now I gotta oil ‘em again.

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Better tighten those bolts, Mr. Fix!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: ...Keola, the Storm Surfer!

effects.speaker: Keola
effects.text: The storm’s rolling in! Just try to stay on your board, huh?

effects.speaker: Keola
effects.text: Agh, wipeout! Guess I didn’t read the clouds right...

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Looks like the tide has turned for Keola!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: ...The Blossoming Battler, Elizabeth!

effects.speaker: Elizabeth
effects.text: My garden blooms brighter than any other!

effects.speaker: Elizabeth
effects.text: Oh, dear... I suppose my garden needs pruning.

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Looks like Elizabeth has wilted under the pressure!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: ...Johnathan, the Stadium Striker, charging in!

effects.speaker: Johnathan
effects.text: Hope you’re quick — I play to win!

effects.speaker: Johnathan
effects.text: What? How could I— red card, red card!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Not what that means! Sorry, you’re out of bounds!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: The Blazing Breath, Keahi!

effects.speaker: Keahi
effects.text: Things are about to heat up!

effects.speaker: Keahi
effects.text: Woah, you beat me! That’s some real fire in your eyes!

effects.speaker: Announcer
effects.text: Looks like Keahi burnt up!

effects.speaker: Dakota
effects.text: ‘Sup, dude! Feelin’ the heat out here?

effects.speaker: Dakota
effects.text: This coast is heated by the volcano, so it’s like a permanent hot tub!

effects.speaker: Dakota
effects.text: I always come out here to do a few laps as my warm-up for the day. And boy does it warm me up! Ha!

effects.speaker: Dakota
effects.text: I feel like takin’ a break though! Wanna have a quick battle?

Caterpie.name: Caterpie
Caterpie.pokedex-entry: If it likes you, it will try to follow you around. Unfortunately, it's not very fast, it sometimes prefers to stick to its trainer's legs.

Metapod.name: Metapod
Metapod.pokedex-entry: Pokémon researchers have concluded that Caterpie has absolutely no idea why they turn into this, and are anxiously hoping that it stops soon. “That's probably fine,” says one such researcher.

Butterfree.name: Butterfree
Butterfree.pokedex-entry: Butterfree have favorite flowers, and return to them often. Some gardeners take extra special care of flowers that they know the local Butterfree like.

Rattata.name: Rattata
Rattata.pokedex-entry: Rattata is the gold standard for test subjects in research studies. They have enough intelligence that researchers need to consider the placebo effect in their studies.

Rattata-Alola.name: Rattata
Rattata-Alola.pokedex-entry: Unlike its mainland cousin, this Pokémon dislikes open spaces. It's known to hoard food, only to forget where it hid that hoard.

Raticate-Alola.name: Raticate
Raticate-Alola.pokedex-entry: Alolan Raticate are very picky about what they eat. They send their Rattata underlings to find fresh food for them.

Spearow.name: Spearow
Spearow.pokedex-entry: Spearow are very stubborn, glaring down and pecking at any Pokémon they view as invading their territory, regardless of size. Nearby Spearow seem to understand this, and join other Spearow exhibiting this behavior to defend their territories.

Fearow.name: Fearow
Fearow.pokedex-entry: Its beak is especially good at fishing Caterpie and other Bug Pokémon out of deep soil. It sees the subtle movements of the grass from high in the air, and dives down to peck the ground at high speeds.

Pikachu.name: Pikachu
Pikachu.pokedex-entry: Nobody has heard of Pikachu. What is this thing

Raichu.name: Raichu
Raichu.pokedex-entry: When agitated enough, it's known to send electric discharges outwards from its body. When that happens, in more ways than one, it needs an outlet.

Raichu-Alola.name: Raichu
Raichu-Alola.pokedex-entry: Some scientists believe that the environment of Alola is better suited to this Pokémon's regional form. Other scientists disagree, saying “he's just chill like that.”

Sandshrew-Alola.name: Sandshrew
Sandshrew-Alola.pokedex-entry: Alolan Sandshrew, like their mainland cousins, curl into a ball and roll away to evade predators. Unlike its cousins, it hasn't fully learned that it's difficult to turn while on ice.

Sandslash-Alola.name: Sandslash
Sandslash-Alola.pokedex-entry: The people of Mount Lanakila often see Sandslash racing down the mountain at high speeds. The residents try to make sure any would-be climbers are aware of the danger.

Jigglypuff.name: Jigglypuff
Jigglypuff.pokedex-entry: Some trainers keep this Pokémon near their beds at night to help them sleep. It can get so invested in this nightly performance that it never seems to catch the moment its trainer falls asleep, and only stops singing when it hears its trainer's snore.

Wigglytuff.name: Wigglytuff
Wigglytuff.pokedex-entry: Its body is incredibly soft, enough that a hug feels like your arms are wrapped around a warm marshmallow. When Wigglypuff takes a deep breath, its body more than doubles in size.

Zubat.name: Zubat
Zubat.pokedex-entry: They navigate the air through echolocation, though some Zubat are better at this than others. It's not unheard of for a Zubat to crash screaming into trainers on late night walks.

Golbat.name: Golbat
Golbat.pokedex-entry: Golbat's fangs are hollow and specialized for sucking blood. Swarms of Golbat have been observed phlebotomizing large Pokémon in events that some Pokémon researchers have deemed “not very fun to watch.”

Paras.name: Paras
Paras.pokedex-entry: The mushrooms on its back are not found on newborn Paras. It is unclear whether these mushrooms begin growing as a result of it maturing or as a result of it being infected somehow.

Parasect.name: Parasect
Parasect.pokedex-entry: The relationship between the creature beneath the mushroom and the mushroom itself is one of the most discussed in the literature of Pokémon research. Researchers have argued whether the parasitic relationship is mutualistic, meaning that both creatures obtain some benefit. A theoretical Parasect that doesn’t have the mushroom infecting it would be unable to perform many Pokémon moves, let alone use its long-since atrophied eye stalks. Until someone discovers a subspecies of Paras or Parasect that have evolved without the mushroom, this topic of endless debate will remain.

Diglett-Alola.name: Diglett
Diglett-Alola.pokedex-entry: The hairs on this Pokémon's head are made of a metallic substance, and are able to receive radio waves. Alolan Diglett appear to be calmed by their favorite music being played from nearby radio stations.

Dugtrio-Alola.name: Dugtrio
Dugtrio-Alola.pokedex-entry: Despite the fact that its thick coat of hair is really just metallic fibers, it seems to enjoy being given a spa treatment. Trainers are advised to use steel wool in place of a regular brush, though.

Meowth-Alola.name: Meowth
Meowth-Alola.pokedex-entry: When this Pokémon sees a person accidentally trip and fall over, it will sneer and laugh at them for minutes on end. However, if its delicate pride is wounded, it will rush at anyone that makes fun of it and claw at them.

Persian-Alola.name: Persian
Persian-Alola.pokedex-entry: Long ago, a royal family brought Meowth into Alola from far away. It became so accustomed to their luxurious treatment that even now it can’t help but act superior.

Psyduck.name: Psyduck
Psyduck.pokedex-entry: Every Psyduck trainer should have heavy-duty ice packs to help with its constant migraines whenever they flare up. Many trainers find gel-based compacts effective, mostly because Psyduck love how squishy they are.

Golduck.name: Golduck
Golduck.pokedex-entry: The moment Golduck evolves, it usually looks around, confused. It takes it a while to become used to the feeling of not being constantly in pain. Trainers should just leave it alone for a while if this happens.

Mankey.name: Mankey
Mankey.pokedex-entry: It’s very risky to bring a Mankey indoors. They will break furniture and appliances without hesitation at the slightest provocation, and they have strong opinions about interior design.

Growlithe.name: Growlithe
Growlithe.pokedex-entry: An extremely loyal Pokémon. Growlithe will stand guard with its trainer as long as it’s awake. It stands vigilant while its trainer is sleeping, and when they wake up, they often find their Growlithe curled up, fast asleep.

Arcanine.name: Arcanine
Arcanine.pokedex-entry: Arcanine is prone to bark loudly at anything it thinks might endanger its trainer. It will bark at strangers, leaves on the ground, and especially a full moon. When a trainer gets an Arcanine, they are legally obligated to notify their neighbors.

Poliwag.name: Poliwag
Poliwag.pokedex-entry: Poliwag trainers without access to a body of water for Poliwag to play in often turn to their bathtubs. Poliwag isn’t yet able to control its speed very well, so trainers often put lots of towels on the bathroom floor to catch its splashes.

Poliwhirl.name: Poliwhirl
Poliwhirl.pokedex-entry: This Pokémon’s signature swirl is really just a facade. Its intestines are tightly wound to give the impression of that swirl, and it can flex different muscles to move its intestines around, giving the impression of a hypnotic spiral. Pokémon researchers have this to say: “Please stop talking about the weird frog it’s gross.”

Abra.name: Abra
Abra.pokedex-entry: Abra's telepathic powers allow it to read the minds of those around it. As Abra teleports around, popping in and out of houses, its dreams are filled with a chaotic mess of memories from different Pokémon and trainers alike.

Kadabra.name: Kadabra
Kadabra.pokedex-entry: The energy emitted by Kadabra’s psychic field affects nearby appliances. Trainers of Kadabra are sure to unplug all their devices before going to bed.

Alakazam.name: Alakazam
Alakazam.pokedex-entry: People that Alakazam dislikes become unable to perceive its presence. A frustrated Alakazam may disappear for a few days, only to return with its trainer having never realized it was gone in the first place.

Machop.name: Machop
Machop.pokedex-entry: Machop loves arm wrestling with its trainer. It wins every time, but still expects its trainer to try their best each time, so that they can get stronger alongside it.

Machoke.name: Machoke
Machoke.pokedex-entry: Some people claim that the belt it wears suppresses its power. However, these claims are often sourced back to people with names like “Matthew Achoke,” so the veracity of these claims is somewhat disputed in many fields of Pokémon research.

Machamp.name: Machamp
Machamp.pokedex-entry: Machamp's arms are so powerful that it could use any one of them to open a jar of pickles without even crying very much.

Tentacool.name: Tentacool
Tentacool.pokedex-entry: Floating around in shallow seas, it doesn’t have much control over where it goes. It often washes up onto the shore, and uses its tentacles to pathetically pull itself back into the water.

Tentacruel.name: Tentacruel
Tentacruel.pokedex-entry: When a Tentacool evolves, it always has exactly 80 tentacles. Tentacles gradually fall out throughout its life, so it prefers to shrink most of them into its body when not in use.

Slowpoke.name: Slowpoke
Slowpoke.pokedex-entry: Streets have signs marking Slowpoke crossing points. If they see a Slowpoke on the road, drivers are encouraged to pull over and move the Slowpoke to its destination. Otherwise, they’d be waiting all day.

Magnemite.name: Magnemite
Magnemite.pokedex-entry: Trainers should train Magnemite in pairs. They bond socially with other Magnemite easily, and enjoy sleeping together with their magnets attached to each other. If a trainer can’t get a second Magnemite, they’re encouraged to at least give the Pokémon a magnet about its size to sleep with.

Grimer-Alola.name: Grimer
Grimer-Alola.pokedex-entry: Unlike regular Grimer, this Pokémon stores its food entirely in its body, in the form of crystals of concentrated poison. Because of these crystals, this Pokémon is almost completely odorless.

Gastly.name: Gastly
Gastly.pokedex-entry: Its body is made almost entirely of poisonous gas. Despite this, some trainers insist that the scent of the gas is, well, to die for.

Haunter.name: Haunter
Haunter.pokedex-entry: Trainers who specialize in Ghost-type Pokémon find Haunter to be one of the most affectionate. It loves playing with its trainer by popping out of objects it haunts.

Drowzee.name: Drowzee
Drowzee.pokedex-entry: A well-trained Drowzee is kept in many hospitals. They eat the bad dreams of patients, and are rewarded with the good dreams of anyone willing to donate them while staying at the hospital.

Hypno.name: Hypno
Hypno.pokedex-entry: It has been 184 days since the last incident involving a Hypno.

Voltorb.name: Voltorb
Voltorb.pokedex-entry: Certain kinds of generators work by having Voltorb and Electrode placed in a large enclosed ring, and spinning that ring very fast. The energy produced this way is surprisingly efficient, and they usually think it’s fun. After all, if they didn’t approve, they would just explode.

Hitmonlee.name: Hitmonlee
Hitmonlee.pokedex-entry: Its legs stretch outward as it kicks. Its body has layers upon layers of muscle coiled up into the shape of a string all along its legs, meaning it has to constantly tense its legs to keep them short. Top-level Pokémon researchers call this phenomenon “not how legs work.”

Chansey.name: Chansey
Chansey.pokedex-entry: Its eggs are renowned for their curatiive properties and delicious taste. Although, if its trainer tries to sell its eggs, Chansey usually get agitated and stop letting its trainer take them.

Goldeen.name: Goldeen
Goldeen.pokedex-entry: Hold on, I need to point something out: Moon’s Pokédex entry for Goldeen calls trainers who train Goldeen and nothing but Goldeen ‘strange.’ No! They have a little guy they like and they’re sticking with it! Those guys are playing Pokémon better than the rest of us.

Seaking.name: Seaking
Seaking.pokedex-entry: Seaking trainers build ponds for them to swim around in, but wild Seaking make their homes in rivers, and swim upstream very quickly. It’s not unheard of for people on a boat to hear a loud bump and suddenly have a Seaking horn-shaped hole in it.

Staryu.name: Staryu
Staryu.pokedex-entry: At night, the red organ at the center of its body pulses in rhythm close to a human’s heartbeat. While its trainer is asleep, the rhythm somehow matches its trainer’s heart perfectly.

Tauros.name: Tauros
Tauros.pokedex-entry: Pokémon ranch owners will tell you that Tauros is a “perfectly kind and polite” Pokémon once it’s well trained. They’ll say that other trainers just “don’t understand” how to take proper care of a Tauros. Maybe they’re right. I still don’t believe them.

Magikarp.name: Magikarp
Magikarp.pokedex-entry: Pokémon researchers are so mean to Magikarp. And for what? Sure, it’s a dumb floppy baby, but does Magikarp care? Yeah it does actually, quite a bit! Magikarp gets very sad when researchers (correctly) describe its complete and utter failure to defend itself or have any viable characteristics for surviving in nature.

Eevee.name: Eevee
Eevee.pokedex-entry: Due to its unstable genetic makeup, its preferences change often. Trainers of this fickle Pokémon may need to make Eevee's habitat just as adaptable as Eevee itself to sate its cravings.

Ledyba.name: Ledyba
Ledyba.pokedex-entry: It’s too timid to explore on its own without a trainer or a swarm of its own kind. One Ledyba was an exception, and became a defense attorney while no one was looking.

Ledian.name: Ledian
Ledian.pokedex-entry: This Pokémon's spots grow larger or smaller depending on how bright the stars in the sky are. When the weather gets bad, they find shelter with local Ledyba wherever they can and huddle together for warmth.

Spinarak.name: Spinarak
Spinarak.pokedex-entry: If a Spinarak has begun spinning webs in your house, it’s a mistake to try to remove the webs on your own, even after removing the Spinarak. Not only will you get the web all over you, but the web’s special thread will be ruined. Many businesses actually offer money to remove the webs for you.

Ariados.name: Ariados
Ariados.pokedex-entry: Its thread is used in weaving especially durable cloth. It’s extremely valuable, leading Ariados to become small in number in some regions.

Pichu.name: Pichu
Pichu.pokedex-entry: It’s not able to control its electric discharges. When a very young Pichu falls asleep, it’s common for its trainer to swaddle it in an insulating blanket.

Igglybuff.name: Igglybuff
Igglybuff.pokedex-entry: It bounces and rolls everywhere it goes, singing its little song. Its singing is... not great. But it's trying.

Mareep.name: Mareep
Mareep.pokedex-entry: Due to the high amount of static electricity, approaching a herd of Mareep should be done with extreme caution.

Flaaffy.name: Flaaffy
Flaaffy.pokedex-entry: Flaaffy accumulates electricity throughout the day. When it’s all charged up, it lets out a constant, low hum.

Ampharos.name: Ampharos
Ampharos.pokedex-entry: When Ampharos sneezes, its body becomes so bright that it looks one of those ridiculously strong flashlights has been pointed at the sky. The beacon of light is fully visible even in broad daylight.

Espeon.name: Espeon
Espeon.pokedex-entry: Its fur has a soft, velvety texture. Its tail twitches when it senses anything intense in its future, so it knows when its opponent will attack and when it will rain. During the weather section of news broadcasts, the host might have an Espeon sitting on screen ready to twitch its tail if it detects anything the host predicts incorrectly.

Murkrow.name: Murkrow
Murkrow.pokedex-entry: Its nest is filled with shiny things it’s found. It’s got a reputation for spreading bad luck, which has overtaken their reputation for being mean little thieves.

Misdreavus.name: Misdreavus
Misdreavus.pokedex-entry: It loves surprising people in any way it can. It appears behind people walking alone at night, just to tap on their shoulder and disappear before they turn around.

Delibird.name: Delibird
Delibird.pokedex-entry: Delibird carry food with them all day. In areas with a local Delibird population, restaurants will give their unused food to wild Delibird.

Houndour.name: Houndour
Houndour.pokedex-entry: They travel in suprisingly well-organized packs. The leader, usually a Houndoom, will hold drills each morning with the younger members of the pack.

Houndoom.name: Houndoom
Houndoom.pokedex-entry: Sometimes, a single howl will come crying out of the forest. For hours after the howl is heard, the forest is silent.

Smeargle.name: Smeargle
Smeargle.pokedex-entry: Some buildings will leave large walls unpainted in a bid to get local Smeargle to paint murals on them. This works every time.

Smoochum.name: Smoochum
Smoochum.pokedex-entry: Smoochum has opinions on fashion and is not shy about them. Trainers say it will tug on sleeves, help fix their trainer’s hair, and sometimes flat-out refuse to let their trainer go outside in an outfit they don’t approve of.

Magby.name: Magby
Magby.pokedex-entry: A famous potter lives with a Magby to help fire their works. The works they create are very highly regarded in the art world. Their Magby doesn’t get as much recognition as the artist themself, sadly. Its name is Hinoko.

Miltank.name: Miltank
Miltank.pokedex-entry: Sometimes in the morning, Pokémon ranch owners will find crop circles have appeared in their fields. Most of the time, it was just a prank orchestrated by Miltank. The rest of the time, it was actually aliens.

Poochyena.name: Poochyena
Poochyena.pokedex-entry: Poochyena is a popular Pokémon online. Its persistent nature means it doesn’t give up chasing its tail easily, and videos of it growling at its reflection are common. One video of a Poochyena playing a song on a banjo is considered a classic.

Wingull.name: Wingull
Wingull.pokedex-entry: Wingull have a habit of lifting food and prey off the ground and carrying them great distances to their nests, or to their trainers.

Pelipper.name: Pelipper
Pelipper.pokedex-entry: pelper Mouth perfec t size for put baby in to n\ap! inside very Soft and Comfort baby sleep soundly put baby in Pelipper Mouth. no problems ever in pelippper mouth because good Shape and Support for baby neck weak of big baby head. Surskit.name: Surskit
Surskit.pokedex-entry: Surskit’s body secretes a liquid that enables it to walk on water. If it’s allowed to roam around its trainer’s house, the floor will quickly be left with long, slippery trails. Trainers with tile floors quickly learn to wear shoes around the house.

Masquerain.name: Masquerain
Masquerain.pokedex-entry: It never really stops thinking that its distinctively eye-shaped wings will fool people. Even if it’s surprised by a trainer it’s known for years, it’ll try to seem like a larger predator with its “eyes.”

Makuhita.name: Makuhita
Makuhita.pokedex-entry: When it gets knocked down, it rolls and slams into things like a bowling ball. Then, without fail, it gets back up.

Hariyama.name: Hariyama
Hariyama.pokedex-entry: Whenever it causes an opponent to faint, it is sure to bow before continuing battle with other Pokémon.

Sableye.name: Sableye
Sableye.pokedex-entry: In the darkness of a cave, it’s not uncommon to see two glittering eyes staring back at you, and as they get closer, the outline of its pointed smile stands out in the pitch black. Then it usually just checks if you have gems for it to eat.

Mawile.name: Mawile
Mawile.pokedex-entry: Its larger rear mouth can’t taste anything, so it uses that mouth to eat food that it doesn’t like. Trainers have to take care of its sharp teeth for Mawile. It purrs contentedly while its trainer takes care of them.

Roselia.name: Roselia
Roselia.pokedex-entry: Roselia loves to be the center of attention in any garden or greenhouse. If it notices its trainer giving more attention to other plants or Pokémon, it's prone to jealousy. On a related note, the flowers on its arms secrete a poisonous nectar.

Spinda.name: Spinda
Spinda.pokedex-entry: Some Pokémon researchers have tried to catalog the billions of different patterns Spinda can have. I wouldn’t know. I’ve definitely never tried to do that.

Barboach.name: Barboach
Barboach.pokedex-entry: It secretes a slimy fluid that makes it almost impossible to hold on to. Some towns hold competitions to see who can hold onto a Barboach the longest as it wriggles out of their hands. Nobody has reached a full minute yet.

Whiscash.name: Whiscash
Whiscash.pokedex-entry: It likes to stay still hidden below a layer of murky swamp water, submerged in the mud as it waits for prey. When it senses people coming, though, it can’t resist coming out of hiding to say hello.

Bagon.name: Bagon
Bagon.pokedex-entry: Some trainers like to take Bagon paragliding with them to satisfy its desire to be able to fly one day. It helps.

Budew.name: Budew
Budew.pokedex-entry: As each and every winter comes to a close, Budew become more active, and their buds open up to spray pollen into the air. The pollen is moderately poisonous, but only in high doses, so anyone planning on training many Budew should be very careful during February.

Roserade.name: Roserade
Roserade.pokedex-entry: A highly dramatic Pokémon, it loves to give performative dances. When its audience applauds, instead of throwing flowers at the performer, Roserade will toss flowers from the bouquets on its arms to its audience.

Cherrim.name: Cherrim
Cherrim.pokedex-entry: When this Pokémon senses a lot of heat, its petals open up to reveal the smiling flower underneath.

Drifloon.name: Drifloon
Drifloon.pokedex-entry: Its habits of leading children away from their families are well known. Trainers of this Pokémon often have to say they “just like the design” or “think the Pokémon’s unique typing is cool.”

Drifblim.name: Drifblim
Drifblim.pokedex-entry: In one experiment, a flock of wild Drifloom was carefully monitored by a drone that could follow their flight. The moment the last sliver of sunlight disappeared off the horizon, the drone’s camera inexplicably shut down irreperably.

Mismagius.name: Mismagius
Mismagius.pokedex-entry: It wanders wherever it wants, muttering incantations which cause misfortune and mischief wherever it goes. However, a well-trained Mismagius can be a great partner, warding misfortune away from its trainer.

Honchkrow.name: Honchkrow
Honchkrow.pokedex-entry: The nest of a Honchkrow is, without fail, littered with shiny objects. Unlike Murkrow, it didn’t collect any itself. Honchkrow will squawk orders at their cronies to collect shiny objects for them.

Bonsly.name: Bonsly
Bonsly.pokedex-entry: It keeps far away from humid environments and hates getting wet. Its tears are nothing more than excess water. If you rub sandpaper on its body, it will giggle happily.

Happiny.name: Happiny
Happiny.pokedex-entry: Its egg is really nothing more than a pale rock it found. Something in its genes tells it that it should be carrying something, so it feels uncomfortable whenever it’s without its rock. #myrock

Finneon.name: Finneon
Finneon.pokedex-entry: During the day, they swim near the surface of the water, soaking up sunlight with the photosensitive pink parts of their bodies. At night, they release the stored energy, and their tails light up the deeper parts of the water.

Glaceon.name: Glaceon
Glaceon.pokedex-entry: It never rains where Glaceon is standing. During thunderstorms, it leaves a trail of light, fluffy snow created from the frozen water droplets as it walks.

Lillipup.name: Lillipup
Lillipup.pokedex-entry: If a Lillipup walks up to you with a stick in its mouth, you have to play fetch with it. This is a federally recognized law in most Pokémon regions.

Herdier.name: Herdier
Herdier.pokedex-entry: It only lets the trainers it trusts most help groom its fur. Without help, its daily ritual of grooming its fur can take hours.

Stoutland.name: Stoutland
Stoutland.pokedex-entry: Rescue teams use this Pokémon to pull hikers out of landslides and avalanches. After a job well done, the team is sure to give Stoutland treats and cuddles.

Roggenrola.name: Roggenrola
Roggenrola.pokedex-entry: It has no eyes, and only knows where to go by listening with the hexagonal ear in the middle of its body. It panics if sounds suddenly start or stop near it, and curls up pretending to be just a regular rock.

Boldore.name: Boldore
Boldore.pokedex-entry: The orange crystals growing on its side are a powerful fuel, so cities will pay trainers of Boldore in exchange for any crystals which have grown too big to stay on the Pokémon.

Cottonee.name: Cottonee
Cottonee.pokedex-entry: Cottonee stick together in flocks as they float across the sky. When enough of them fly together, the flock resembles a passing cloud to people below.

Whimsicott.name: Whimsicott
Whimsicott.pokedex-entry: It rides the wind, bounding around wherever it leads. It loves slipping into homes through open windows and spreading its cotton all over in a huge mess.

Petilil.name: Petilil
Petilil.pokedex-entry: Petilil leaves are used frequently in cooking, mostly as a substitute for leaves from the much rarer Bayleef. The leaves grow right back within a day. It’s tradition to give it a bowl of fertilizer as a treat whenever its leaves are removed.

Lilligant.name: Lilligant
Lilligant.pokedex-entry: The flower on its head is especially difficult to get to bloom, and even harder to maintain. A blooming Lilligant is a symbol of high status, though only a temporary one.

Lilligant-Hisui.name: Lilligant
Lilligant-Hisui.pokedex-entry: Trainers of this unusual variant of Lilligant often find themselves changing their whole daily routine around it— taking jogs through forests, ballet classes, or just laying in the grass with their Pokémon.

Zorua.name: Zorua
Zorua.pokedex-entry: Wild Zorua like to play pretend and disguise as people. Everything else they tried didn’t work, so in towns and cities near forests where Zorua reside, they have “Safe Disguise Zones” where Zorua can play pretend all it wants. Most Zorua respect the boundaries as long as they have people to play with.

Minccino.name: Minccino
Minccino.pokedex-entry: When these Pokémon see something they like, they bounce happily and start brushing it with their tails. Sttaching one to the end of a stick and using them like a feather duster is considered somewhat rude, but a totally valid form of enrichment for Minccino. Some of them really like it.

Alomomola.name: Alomomola
Alomomola.pokedex-entry: Lifeguards on busy beaches often rely on Alomomola patrolling the deeper waters far from the shore, where even strong swimmers can get into trouble. Alomomola have a strong sense of danger, and can carry people and Pokémon back to shore.

Klink.name: Klink
Klink.pokedex-entry: Klink love to sleep where they're most comfortable, surrounded by whirring machinery. They are known to form strong bonds with anything in the house that spins regularly, and will quickly grow attached to fans or washing machines. If they suddenly stop spinning, Klink grows distressed.

Rufflet.name: Rufflet
Rufflet.pokedex-entry: Rufflet will pick fights with any and every nearby Pokémon. It loses this habit quickly when caught, but some trainers enjoy the way it challenges Pokémon a hundred times its size.

Vullaby.name: Vullaby
Vullaby.pokedex-entry: The bones worn by Vullaby are the subject of intense research. No known Pokémon has bones of the exact shape worn by Vullaby, and nobody has ever witnessed the moment a Vullaby finds its shell. Some researchers theorize that the shell is actually a sort of exoskeleton, believed to be shed from the Pokémon while it’s still in its egg.

Fletchling.name: Fletchling
Fletchling.pokedex-entry: When it’s very happy, the markings on its eyes glow as the heat of its body rises. This behavior is often observed the day it learns to fly.

Litleo.name: Litleo
Litleo.pokedex-entry: It loves swinging its paws at anything dangling in front of it. Sometimes, that’s a Pyroar’s tail, and it gets burned. Litleo trainers wanting to play with their Pokémon use something durable, like a metal chain.

Pancham.name: Pancham
Pancham.pokedex-entry: It thinks that the leaf in its mouth makes it look cooler and more intimidating. Videos of people pretending to be scared off by Pancham, only to record its happy face at the end, are quite popular online.

Pangoro.name: Pangoro
Pangoro.pokedex-entry: Pangoro often take Pancham in and train them as students. Pancham trained this way are much less mischievous, and love challenging themselves with more powerful opponents.

Furfrou.name: Furfrou
Furfrou.pokedex-entry: Furfrou is a famously fashionable Pokémon that sports many different styles. Or at least 3 different styles. Pokémon researchers are “pretty sure” that there “were” “more” styles that “Furfrou” could wear, but the other ones were unfortunately lost in “an” explosion accident.

Espurr.name: Espurr
Espurr.pokedex-entry: Trainers quickly learn to build “stillness time” into their days for Espurr. It absolutely needs to be left alone in a dim room for a few hours every day. When it’s especially calm, it smiles, but only on the inside.

Carbink.name: Carbink
Carbink.pokedex-entry: Carbink are born deep underground in areas with high pressure and even higher temperature. They slowly rise from the soil at a glacially slow pace. For a (comparatively) brief period as they emerge, they look like nothing more than a regular crystal poking from the ground or wall.

Noibat.name: Noibat
Noibat.pokedex-entry: Many researchers laud this Pokémon's ability to emit 200,000 hertz screeches, which it uses in echolocation and in battle. However, its ears are impressive too! High frequency sounds reflect off of objects more than they pass through, which means even more of that powerful sound gets back to Noibat. So really, the Pokémon that hears Noibat's screeches the most is Noibat itself!

Rowlet.name: Rowlet
Rowlet.pokedex-entry: During the day, it likes resting basically anywhere, often using its trainer’s backpack as a makeshift nest. It sleeps with its head facing up at the sun, and gets more active as the sun sets.

Dartrix.name: Dartrix
Dartrix.pokedex-entry: This Pokémon preens itself frequently, removing anything unsightly from its feathers. When it ambushes its prey, it moves almost completely silently before clutching the prey in its claws.

Decidueye.name: Decidueye
Decidueye.pokedex-entry: Trainers with gardens use Decidueye to stop pests. During the night, no sounds are heard, but the plants never see holes bitten into their leaves again.

Litten.name: Litten
