Own Tempo.name: Own Tempo
Own Tempo.longDescription: This Pokémon can’t be confused during battle.

Pickup.name: Pickup
Pickup.shortDescription: Gets some energy from the opponent's 4-in-a-row matches
Pickup.longDescription: When the opponent makes a 4-in-a-row match, this Pokémon gets some energy as well. The energy added is equal to 1/2 of the energy added by that match and any matches made simultaneously with it, rounded up.

Plus.name: Plus
Plus.shortDescription: Raises Special Attack by 50% when it enters if another Pokémon has Plus or Minus
Plus.longDescription: When this Pokémon is put into play, if its user has another Pokémon with Plus or Minus, this Pokémon's Special Attack is increased by 50%.

Poison Point.name: Poison Point
Poison Point.shortDescription: Poisons the attacker when they make contact 30% of the time
Poison Point.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, this ability has a 30% chance to apply Poisoned to the attacker. Whenever a poisoned Pokémon uses a move, it takes damage equal to 1/16 of its max HP.

Poison Touch.name: Poison Touch
Poison Touch.shortDescription: Poisons the defender upon making contact 30% of the time
Poison Touch.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon deals damage to another Pokémon through a move that makes contact, this ability has a 30% chance to apply Poisoned to the defender. Whenever a poisoned Pokémon uses a move, it takes damage equal to 1/16 of its max HP.

Power of Alchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
Power of Alchemy.shortDescription: Copies the ability of the most recently fainted Pokémon.
Power of Alchemy.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon owned by this Pokémon's trainer faints, this Pokémon gains that fainted Pokémon's ability.

Prankster.name: Prankster
Prankster.longDescription: Status moves this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Quick Feet.name: Quick Feet
Quick Feet.shortDescription: Speed is increased by 50% while this Pokémon has a status condition.
Quick Feet.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon has a status condition, its Speed stat is increased by 50%.

Rain Dish.name: Rain Dish
Rain Dish.shortDescription: On a Water-type 4-in-a-row or more, heals 20% of max HP
Rain Dish.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Water tiles in a row, this Pokémon heals HP equal to 20% of its max HP.

Rattled.name: Rattled
Rattled.shortDescription: Raise Speed a stage when hit with Bug, Ghost, or Dark moves
Rattled.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon is dealt Bug-, Ghost-, or Dark-type damage, its Speed is increased by 1 stage. This also triggers whenever another Pokémon uses Intimidate against this Pokémon.

Receiver.name: Receiver
Receiver.shortDescription: Copies the ability of the most recently fainted Pokémon.
Receiver.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon owned by this Pokémon's trainer faints, this Pokémon gains that fainted Pokémon's ability.

Reckless.name: Reckless
Reckless.shortDescription: Moves with recoil have 20% more power
Reckless.longDescription: Moves which this Pokémon uses which deal recoil damage to their user have their power increased by 20%.

Regenerator.name: Regenerator
Regenerator.shortDescription: On switching out, heal based on how long it was active
Regenerator.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon's user switches it out, it heals HP based on how many turns it was active.

Rivalry.name: Rivalry
Rivalry.shortDescription: Increases move power by 50% while both Pokémon are above 75% HP.
Rivalry.longDescription: As long as both Pokémon are both above 75% HP, this Pokémon’s moves have their power increased by 50%.

Rock Head.name: Rock Head
Rock Head.longDescription: Moves that deal recoil damage to their user don't deal recoil to this Pokémon.

Run Away.name: Run Away
Run Away.shortDescription: Raises Speed 2 stages if damaged last turn
Run Away.longDescription: At the end of each turn, if this Pokémon was dealt damage during that turn, its Speed stat is raised 2 stages during the next turn.

Sand Force.name: Sand Force
Sand Force.shortDescription: On a Fighting-type 4-in-a-row or more, increase the power of the next Rock/Ground/Steel move used by 50%
Sand Force.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Fighting tiles in a row, the power of the next Rock-, Ground-, or Steel-type move this Pokémon uses is increased by 50%.

Sand Rush.name: Sand Rush
Sand Rush.shortDescription: On a Fighting-type 4-in-a-row or more, doubles Speed for 4 turns
Sand Rush.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Fighting tiles in a row, this Pokémon's Speed stat is doubled for 4 turns.

Sand Veil.name: Sand Veil
Sand Veil.shortDescription: On a Fighting-type 4-in-a-row or more, increase Speed a stage
Sand Veil.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Fighting tiles in a row, this Pokémon's Speed stat increases by 1 stage.

Sap Sipper.name: Sap Sipper
Sap Sipper.shortDescription: Raises Attack a stage when hit with a Grass-type move
Sap Sipper.longDescription: When this Pokémon is dealt damage by a Grass-type move, its Attack is increased by a stage.

Schooling.name: Schooling
Schooling.shortDescription: While at more than 25% HP and at level 20 or above, change to a more powerful form
Schooling.longDescription: As this Pokémon enters, if its level is at least 20 and it has more than 25% HP remaining, it changes to its more powerful School form.

Scrappy.name: Scrappy
Scrappy.longDescription: As long as the defending Pokémon is Ghost type, all moves which would have a type effectiveness of 0 have a type effectiveness of 1 instead.

Serene Grace.name: Serene Grace
Serene Grace.shortDescription: Moves with additional effects cost 30% less
Serene Grace.longDescription: Moves which have additional effects this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Shed Skin.name: Shed Skin
Shed Skin.shortDescription: At the end of its turn, 20% chance to cure one status
Shed Skin.longDescription: At the end of this Pokémon's turn, it has a 20% chance to recover from one non-volatile status that it has.

Sheer Force.name: Sheer Force
Sheer Force.shortDescription: Prevents additional effects, but increases power
Sheer Force.longDescription: When this Pokémon uses a move, if it has additional effects, its power is increased by 30%, but any additional effects of the move are prevented.

Shield Dust.name: Shield Dust
Shield Dust.shortDescription: Prevents receiving status effects from opponent 20% of the time
Shield Dust.longDescription: If this Pokémon receives a status effect from another trainer, it has a 20% chance to prevent it.

Skill Link.name: Skill Link
Skill Link.shortDescription: Increases move power by 5 for each move used earlier this turn
Skill Link.longDescription: The power of moves this Pokémon uses is increased by 5 for each move that it used earlier this turn.

Slush Rush.name: Slush Rush
Slush Rush.shortDescription: On a Water-type 4-in-a-row or more, doubles Speed for 4 turns
Slush Rush.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Water tiles in a row, this Pokémon's Speed stat is doubled for 4 turns.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.shortDescription: On a 5-in-a-row, next move's power is doubled
Sniper.longDescription: When this Pokémon makes a 5-in-a-row match during this Pokémon's turn, the power of its next move is doubled.

Snow Cloak.name: Snow Cloak
Snow Cloak.shortDescription: On a Water-type 4-in-a-row or more, enemy damage-dealing moves cost 40% more for 3 turns.
Snow Cloak.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 or more Water tiles in a row, the next time that the opponent uses a damage-dealing move, it costs 40% more.

Soundproof.name: Soundproof
Soundproof.shortDescription: The opponent’s sound-based moves are prevented.
Soundproof.longDescription: Sound-based moves that the opponent uses have their effects prevented completely.

Stakeout.name: Stakeout
Stakeout.shortDescription: Doubles move power against Pokémon that just switched in
Stakeout.longDescription: Moves that this Pokémon uses against Pokémon which have been active for 2 or fewer turns have their power increased by 100%.

Stall.name: Stall
Stall.shortDescription: +50 max initiative, but +50% energy from matches, rounded up.
Stall.longDescription: This Pokémon requires 50 additional initiative before they can take a turn. However, the energy they gain from making matches is increased by 50%, rounded up.

Stamina.name: Stamina
Stamina.shortDescription: Being damaged raises Defense by a stage
Stamina.longDescription: When this Pokémon takes damage, its Defense is raised by a stage.

Static.name: Static
Static.shortDescription: Paralyzes the attacker when they make contact 30% of the time
Static.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, this ability has a 30% chance to apply Paralyzed to the attacker.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.shortDescription: Raises Speed a stage when its initiative is lowered
Steadfast.longDescription: When this Pokémon's initiative is lowered, its Speed is increased by a stage.

Storm Drain.name: Storm Drain
Storm Drain.shortDescription: Gains 50% of the blue energy opponents gain through matches
Storm Drain.longDescription: Whenever the opponent gains blue energy through a match, this Pokémon gains 50% of that blue energy as well, rounded up.

Strong Jaw.name: Strong Jaw
Strong Jaw.shortDescription: This Pokémon's biting moves get +50% power
Strong Jaw.longDescription: The power of biting moves used by this Pokémon are increased by 50%.

Sturdy.name: Sturdy
Sturdy.longDescription: Damage taken while this Pokémon's HP is full causes it to drop to 1 HP instead.

Super Luck.name: Super Luck
Super Luck.shortDescription: 10% of the time and once per turn, makes its last move used free and reset its cooldown
Super Luck.longDescription: After this Pokémon finishes using a move, 10% of the time, the cooldown for that move is reset to 0, and its next activation this turn costs no energy.

Surge Surfer.name: Surge Surfer
Surge Surfer.shortDescription: Gain extra speed while there's a lot of Electric tiles
Surge Surfer.longDescription: Reduces this Pokémon's speed by 25%. However, its speed increases by 5% for each Electric tile on the board.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.shortDescription: Bug moves are stronger at low health
Swarm.longDescription: Bug moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Sweet Veil.name: Sweet Veil
Sweet Veil.shortDescription: Prevents sleep. Also, Fairy tiles may spawn. Fairy tiles are worth 1 green AND blue energy.
Sweet Veil.longDescription: This Pokémon can’t be put to sleep. As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, the weight of Fairy tiles is increased by 0.5. (The normal weight is 0.) Fairy tiles are worth 1 green AND 1 blue energy.

Swift Swim.name: Swift Swim
Swift Swim.shortDescription: Gain extra speed based on Water tiles
Swift Swim.longDescription: This Pokémon’s speed increases by 1% per Water tile on the board.

Synchronize.name: Synchronize
Synchronize.shortDescription: Copies received Paralyze and Poisoned statuses for the opponent
Synchronize.longDescription: When this Pokémon receives the Paralyze or Poisoned status effects from an effect of a move, the opponent also gets the same status.

Tangled Feet.name: Tangled Feet
Tangled Feet.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is confused, its Speed stat is doubled.

Tangling Hair.name: Tangling Hair
Tangling Hair.shortDescription: Lowers an attacker's Speed when they make contact with this Pokémon
Tangling Hair.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, the attacker has their Speed reduced by a stage.

Technician.name: Technician
Technician.shortDescription: Moves with power 60 or less have their power raised 50%
Technician.longDescription: Moves that this Pokémon uses which have a power of 60 or less have their power raised by 50%.

Telepathy.name: Telepathy
Telepathy.shortDescription: At the start of its turn, gains 1 energy of each color its opponent gained since its last turn
Telepathy.longDescription: At the start of this Pokémon's turn, it gains 1 energy of each color of energy that its opponent has gained since the start of this Pokémon's previous turn.

Thick Fat.name: Thick Fat
Thick Fat.shortDescription: Reduces damage taken from Fire- or Ice-type moves.
Thick Fat.longDescription: When this Pokémon receives damage from a Fire- or Ice-type move, the attacker's relevant attack stat is reduced by 50%.

Tinted Lens.name: Tinted Lens
Tinted Lens.shortDescription: “Not very effective” moves used do double damage.
Tinted Lens.longDescription: As a move this Pokémon uses deals damage, if the type effectiveness of that damage is 0.5 or less, its damage is doubled.

Torrent.name: Torrent
Torrent.shortDescription: Water moves are stronger at low health
Torrent.longDescription: Water moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Tough Claws.name: Tough Claws
Tough Claws.shortDescription: This Pokémon's moves that make contact get +30% power
Tough Claws.longDescription: The power of moves that make contact used by this Pokémon are increased by 30%.

Triage.name: Triage
Triage.longDescription: Healing moves this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Unaware.name: Unaware
Unaware.shortDescription: Ignores the opponent's stats while dealing or receiving damage from them.
Unaware.longDescription: Whenever damage is dealt by a move from another Pokémon, any changes made to the opponent's stats are ignored.

Unburden.name: Unburden
Unburden.shortDescription: Raises Speed a stage when its owner pays exactly as much energy as they have in a color
Unburden.longDescription: Whenever paying for a move causes at least one of this Pokémon's energy colors to fall to become completely empty, its Speed is increased by 1 stage.

Unnerve.name: Unnerve
Unnerve.shortDescription: The first move the opponent uses each turn costs 1 more energy of each color
Unnerve.longDescription: As long as the opponent hasn't used a move this turn, moves they use cost 1 more energy in each nonzero part of their energy cost.

Vital Spirit.name: Vital Spirit
Vital Spirit.longDescription: This Pokémon can’t be put to sleep during battle.

Water Absorb.name: Water Absorb
Water Absorb.longDescription: Being dealt Water-type damage heals this Pokémon instead of damaging it.

Water Bubble.name: Water Bubble
Water Bubble.shortDescription: Takes half damage from Fire moves, deals double damage with Water moves, can’t be burned
Water Bubble.longDescription: Damage that this Pokémon takes from Fire moves is halved and damage it deals with Water moves is doubled. It’s also immune to being burned.

Water Veil.name: Water Veil
Water Veil.shortDescription: The opponent’s moves can’t burn tiles
Water Veil.longDescription: Effects of moves the opponent uses which give the Burned status to tiles are prevented.

Weak Armor.name: Weak Armor
Weak Armor.shortDescription: Getting hit with Physical moves lowers Defense by a stage and raises Speed by two stages
Weak Armor.longDescription: When another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon with a Physical move, its Defense is lowered by one stage, but its Speed is raised by two stages.

seedling.name: Seedling

aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring

tormented.name: Tormented
tormented.description: This Pokémon can’t use the same move twice in a row.

Route 1-1.name: Route 1-1
Route 1-1.description: You arrive in Alola and meet your first Pokémon trainer.

Route 1-2.name: Route 1-2
Route 1-2.description: You leave Iki town and head along the first leg of the journey, Route 1.

Route 1-6.name: Route 1-6
Route 1-6.description: After your battle with Hau, you continue towards Hau'oli City.

Route 1-7.name: Route 1-7
Route 1-7.description: You reach the trainers' school with Lillie, and get mistaken for somebody else.

Route 2-1.name: Route 2-1
Route 2-1.description: You reach Hau'oli city, and explore for a while with Lillie and Hau.

Route 2-2.name: Route 2-2
Route 2-2.description: You find Ilima relaxing at the Marina.

Route 2-3.name: Route 2-3
Route 2-3.description: You begin to explore the rest of Melemele Island.

Route 2-4.name: Route 2-4
Route 2-4.description: You continue to explore the rest of Melemele Island.

Route 2-5.name: Route 2-5
Route 2-5.description: A small cemetery sits on the outskirts of the island.

Route 2-6.name: Route 2-6
Route 2-6.description: Team Skull is causing some trouble at a berry farm.

Route 2-7.name: Route 2-7
Route 2-7.description: You arrive at Verdant Cavern, where Ilima is hosting his Island Challenge.

Route 3-1.name: Route 3-1
Route 3-1.description: On your way to the next trial, you climb through a rocky pass overlooking Kala'e Bay.

Route 3-2.name: Route 3-2
Route 3-2.description: You feel the shadows of flying Pokémon pass over your head as you continue.

Route 3-3.name: Route 3-3
Route 3-3.description: Off the beaten path, you find a meadow filled with yellow flowers.

Route 3-4.name: Rival Battle 3
Route 3-4.description: Heading back to Iki Town, you meet back up with Hau.

Route 3-5.name: Route 3-5
Route 3-5.description: Once you arrive at Iki Town, the kahuna Hala is waiting, challenging trainers.

Route 3-6.name: Route 3-6
Route 3-6.description: Before heading to Akala, you step into a cave along Ten Carat Hill.

Route 3-7.name: Route 3-7
Route 3-7.description: Through the cave is a secluded valley with some rare Pokémon in it.

Route 4-1.name: Route 4-1
Route 4-1.description: You step off the boat and onto the sandy beach of Akala Island. Heahea City is right next to the dock, and you stop at the Tide Song Hotel there.

Route 4-2.name: Route 4-2
Route 4-2.description: The hotel overlooks a winding forest path, filled with new Pokémon native to Akala Island.

Route 4-3.name: Route 4-3
Route 4-3.description: Deeper in the forest, different Pokémon can be found around a small spring.

Route 4-4.name: Rival Battle 4
Route 4-4.description: As you walk into the dusty, sun-soaked streets of Paniola Town, Hau spots you, and runs up to you for a battle.

Route 4-5.name: Route 4-5
Route 4-5.description: On the outskirts of the town is Paniola Ranch, where something's clearly stirred up the Tauros more than usual.

Route 4-6.name: Route 4-6
Route 4-6.description: You pass the ranch and continue along the path into the forest as the trees around you grow more dense.

Route 4-7.name: Route 4-7
Route 4-7.description: As you leave the forest, you find Hau being accosted by a stranger.

Route 5-1.name: Route 5-1
Route 5-1.description: As you step into Brooklet Hill, you start looking for the next trial captain, as well as some new Pokémon.

Route 5-2.name: Route 5-2
Route 5-2.description: You follow where you saw Lana go, further along the path.

Route 5-3.name: Route 5-3
Route 5-3.description: Once the lake is cleared out, you and Lana are finally able to start your trial at Brooklet Hill.

Route 5-4.name: Route 5-4
Route 5-4.description: You climb down from Brooklet Hill and come across a path connecting Paniola Town to the next leg of the journey.

Route 5-5.name: Route 5-5
Route 5-5.description: The path leads through Royal Avenue, a long street overlooked by a towering dome with neon lights shining above its entrance.

Route 5-6.name: Route 5-6
Route 5-6.description: Forging ahead, at the base of Akala's massive volcano, the rocky path curves around a body of water heated by the magma underground.
